features.description: A random multiplier symbol appears during free spins.

review:
Doddy And Haddzy Bonanza is a Viking-styled Bonanza game made with two popular streamers. Refilling reels let symbols pay anywhere, and wins can chain within a single spin.

Four or more scatters trigger free spins, and scatters also pay in any position. During the bonus, a multiplier symbol takes a random value from 2x to 100x. Chance x2 improves the odds of four scatters, and the bonus buy ensures a bonus on the next spin where permitted. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 10,200x maximum and a 96% RTP. Free spins come along roughly once every 398 spins. Mechanically it matches Aztec Magic Bonanza; choose it for the Viking theme.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
